about.title: About
about.paragraph1: {siteName} was founded to solve a simple problem: planning a trip to Uman involves dozens of phone calls, WhatsApp groups and scattered ads. We bring everything you need together in one place - verified hotels, reliable drivers and guided tours - so you can focus on what matters.
about.paragraph2: Every hotel, driver and tour guide on the site has gone through basic verification by us. We always recommend coordinating directly with the service provider before payment, and keeping communication through the platform as much as possible.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.paragraph1: {siteName} serves as a platform connecting travelers with independent hotels, drivers and tour guides operating in Uman. The actual booking, payment and service are provided by the service provider (the hotel owner/driver/guide), not by the platform itself.
terms.paragraph2: A fixed platform fee is charged for use of the service, in addition to the price paid directly to the service provider. Fee details are shown during the booking process.
terms.paragraph3: Cancellations and changes are subject to the specific service provider's cancellation policy. We recommend checking the cancellation policy before confirming a booking.
terms.paragraph4: Using the site constitutes agreement to these terms. We reserve the right to update these terms from time to time.
